summary: The comment emphasizes the importance of libraries as a free access point to the internet, highlighting personal experiences of using libraries for accessing online services such as unemployment benefits and job applications. It opposes any restrictions on screen-time limits for E-Rate programs, arguing that libraries provide essential free access to the internet without such limitations.

claims.argument: The comment argues against imposing screen-time limits on E-Rate programs, asserting that libraries provide free access to the internet without restrictions.
claims.evidence_quote: When I suddenly became unemployed I went to the library to submit job applications as well as upload all of my unemployment forms. I would not have been able to do that without the library and its free access to the internet.
